scope: Externally authored Apache POI regression and feature documents, including website-named samples; not a claim that every file is an unmodified production document.

selection.excluded: Fuzzer/mutated, explicitly password-protected, macro-named and truncated samples were not selected. Documents may contain external relationships and embedded resources, which are treated as data.
selection.sourceCategories: Classification uses filenames; website-named files are preserved as upstream samples and have not been re-fetched from their original sites.
